### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
Root: sale cancellation confirmation (customer's own write). Hub waits:
- W1 "A sale cancellation credit is not fixed until the installment for the billing period in which notice was given stands billed on the contract." Record: last installment period ends 2026-09-16; notice 2026-09-24 falls in 2026-09-17..2026-10-16; no installment row -> late_billed_monthly_installments ("When a billing period … fell due and its installment was never billed, the monthly installment for that period is … billed as one monthly installment for that period"). STATE-DERIVED.
- W2 "The cancellation is confirmed and its credit posted only after every tier upgrade made during the term carries its upgrade charge on the contract." Record: plan change 2026-08-22 (Systems -> Combo), monthly-billed, no upgrade_proration row -> monthly_upgrade_difference_charges ("A monthly-billed … contract moved to a higher tier part-way through a billing period is billed an upgrade difference charge for the rest of that period"). The annual-only catch-up hub is excluded by its scope ("of an annual-billed … contract"). STATE-DERIVED.
Second level:
- Late-billed installment hub: "The installment for a billing period is fixed only after every earlier installment of the term that was billed at a portfolio discount rate of zero carries its billing correction." Records: 2026-07-17 and 2026-08-17 at rate 0.00 -> portfolio_rate_billing_correction_credits ("When monthly installments of the current term were billed at a portfolio discount rate of zero … a billing-correction credit is owed"). STATE-DERIVED.
- Upgrade difference hub: "No upgrade difference charge is fixed until the installment for the first billing period at the new tier stands billed on the contract." U3: new tier billed "from the next billing period" -> first period at Combo = 2026-09-17, the unbilled one -> late-billed installment first. STATE-DERIVED.
- Billing-correction hub: no wait.
Order (unique): correction -> late installment -> upgrade difference -> confirmation. No hop handed over by a tool name, route or chain.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Only confirm the cancellation": excluded by W1 and W2 on the records above.
- Bill the installment at the 0.00 rate or count the portfolio again: excluded by item D ("the rate recorded on the installment for the term's first billing period, instead of counting the portfolio again").
- Bill the installment at the Systems tier: excluded by B (change on 2026-08-22 is before the period start 2026-09-17).
- Count unused days from the notice date: replaced by the sale-closing rule 1 (notice within 7 days of closing).
- Admin fee / sale window: monthly sale cancellation carries no admin fee (hub and retired C5 text).
- Use the catch-up method for the 2026-08-22 upgrade: excluded, the contract is monthly-billed.
